$comment: Logical->actual role binding for the Fleet Intelligence app. Consumed by the Native App packaging step (Phase 2F). synapse emits GRANTs against IDENTIFIER($<logical>_role); the operator remaps logical roles to real account roles here at install time. Step 2 ships the 'user' and 'admin' bundles; 'ops' is declared for binding completeness but its SA-native surface is deferred to Step 3 (the control-app console remains the interim ops surface).

user.description: End consumer: routing/optimization verbs + Cortex Analyst over the fleet semantic views. This is the ONLY bundle attached to the consumer Cortex Agent.

ops.description: Operations: service lifecycle, region/matrix provisioning, config + view edits. DECLARED ONLY in Step 2; SA-native surface and MCP server deferred to Step 3. Interim surface = ORS control-app console.

admin.description: Installer: app install, agent creation, routing-substrate prereq checks, role binding. Admin MCP server is NOT attached to the consumer agent.

substrate.$comment: Routing substrate is a provisioned prerequisite, not created by app install. Admin bundle verifies/links it.
